[issue by ashton727]
### Minecraft Version

1.21

### Mod Loader

NeoForge

### Mod Loader Version

21.0.46

### Mod Version

21.0.11

### Balm Version

21.0.11

### Describe the Issue

1. Start neoforge 21.0.46 server with balm
2. Observe crash

### Logs

https://pastebin.com/4asPjjkH

### Do you use any performance-enhancing mods (e.g. OptiFine) or custom server distributions (e.g. SpongeForge)?

no

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Try Java 21

[comment by ashton727 (none)]
This version of Neoforge requires Java 22 I believe.

[comment by BlayTheNinth (member)]
Minecraft 1.21 uses Java 21 and the error you're getting is because Mixin cannot load the JRE 22 (file major version 66) classes.

[comment by ashton727 (none)]
Realized its been running on 21 the whole time. Still crashes on startup.
